value.summary: The PR title and body accurately describe the diff: the scan/deep models are moved from minimax-m3 and kimi-k3 to z-ai/glm-5.2, the fallback chain is changed to deepseek-v4-pro and minimax-m3, reasoning becomes configurable via a new `reasoning_effort` field (defaulting to `"high"`) instead of being hard-disabled, and every model named in the description gets a price entry in `harness::pricing`. The description's claims about the fallback chain, reasoning hazard, tier separation, and verification (fmt/clippy/test counts) all correspond to concrete code and test additions in the diff. No significant change in the diff is left unmentioned, and nothing in the description claims a change the diff does not make.
